titleEn: Minimum Total Space Wasted With K Resizing Operations
title: K 次调整数组大小浪费的最小总空间
summary: 数组容量在每段内固定且不得小于需求，最多调整 k 次，求各时刻容量减需求的最小浪费总和。
insight: 最多调整 k 次等价于把数组分为至多 k+1 个连续段。预计算任意段的浪费 max(segment)*length-sum(segment)，再做分段 DP。
pitfalls: 初始设置容量不计调整
每段最优容量是该段最大需求
允许少于 k 次调整

solutions.title: 区间代价分段 DP
solutions.idea: 把容量调整位置视为连续分段边界。
steps: dp[groups][end] 表示前 end 项分 groups 段的最小浪费
枚举最后一段 start，转移 dp[g-1][start]+waste[start][end-1]；取 groups<=k+1 最小

code.java: class Solution { public int minSpaceWastedKResizing(int[] nums,int k){int n=nums.length;int[][] waste=new int[n][n];for(int left=0;left<n;left++){int maximum=0,sum=0;for(int right=left;right<n;right++){maximum=Math.max(maximum,nums[right]);sum+=nums[right];waste[left][right]=maximum*(right-left+1)-sum;}}int infinity=1_000_000_000;int[][] dp=new int[k+2][n+1];for(int[] row:dp)Arrays.fill(row,infinity);dp[0][0]=0;int answer=infinity;for(int groups=1;groups<=k+1;groups++)for(int end=1;end<=n;end++)for(int start=0;start<end;start++)if(dp[groups-1][start]<infinity)dp[groups][end]=Math.min(dp[groups][end],dp[groups-1][start]+waste[start][end-1]);for(int groups=1;groups<=k+1;groups++)answer=Math.min(answer,dp[groups][n]);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minSpaceWastedKResizing(nums:IntArray,k:Int):Int{val n=nums.size;val waste=Array(n){IntArray(n)};for(left in 0 until n){var maximum=0;var sum=0;for(right in left until n){maximum=maxOf(maximum,nums[right]);sum+=nums[right];waste[left][right]=maximum*(right-left+1)-sum}};val infinity=1_000_000_000;val dp=Array(k+2){IntArray(n+1){infinity}};dp[0][0]=0;for(groups in 1..k+1)for(end in 1..n)for(start in 0 until end)if(dp[groups-1][start]<infinity)dp[groups][end]=minOf(dp[groups][end],dp[groups-1][start]+waste[start][end-1]);return (1..k+1).minOf{dp[it][n]}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minSpaceWastedKResizing(vector<int>& nums,int k){int n=nums.size(),INF=1000000000;vector<vector<int>> waste(n,vector<int>(n));for(int left=0;left<n;++left){int maximum=0,sum=0;for(int right=left;right<n;++right){maximum=max(maximum,nums[right]);sum+=nums[right];waste[left][right]=maximum*(right-left+1)-sum;}}vector<vector<int>> dp(k+2,vector<int>(n+1,INF));dp[0][0]=0;for(int groups=1;groups<=k+1;++groups)for(int end=1;end<=n;++end)for(int start=0;start<end;++start)if(dp[groups-1][start]<INF)dp[groups][end]=min(dp[groups][end],dp[groups-1][start]+waste[start][end-1]);int answer=INF;for(int groups=1;groups<=k+1;++groups)answer=min(answer,dp[groups][n]);return answer;} };
